grounds.name: Navy
grounds.usage: Opt-in ground for a product whose mark sits on navy (ai-router): set data-ground="navy" next to data-theme on <html>. Moves the workspace greys onto the x-color navy ramp; accents, status colours and the brand stay as they are. Text-3 keeps 4.5:1 on every step.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Workspace ground: the window behind every pane, input wells in dialogs and fields. The deepest step: bg-0 < term < bg-1 < bg-2 < bg-3 in dark; in light the ground is the darkest grey and term the white page.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Workspace chrome: header, tab strip, footer, sidebars, palette, settings cards. One step off the editor (term), so the side columns read as a frame around it.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: menus, toasts, switch tracks, secondary buttons in panes.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill for icon buttons, menu items, tab close; empty meter track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline in the workspace: pane borders, tab dividers, menu edges, field borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Alias of x-color-line-strong for the workspace grounds: the edge of a control whose border is its only visible boundary (fields, checkboxes, radios, switches). At least 3:1 on bg-0 to bg-3, term and side-tint.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-0 to bg-3.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, idle tab labels, footer text, icon-button glyphs on bg-0 to bg-3.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta text: palette section labels, placeholders, timestamps, counts. At least 4.5:1 on bg-0 to bg-3, term and side-tint in both themes; still the quietest text step, below text-2.

tokens.name: side-tint
tokens.usage: Left sidebar ground when Appearance > Sidebar is Tinted: bg-1 with a faint accent wash. Text-1 and text-2 keep their contrast on it.

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: Terminal and editor ground; the selected tab takes it so the tab joins its pane. White in light, between bg-0 and bg-1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue in the workspace: selected-tab top rule, on switches, merged PR dot, the mark.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Agent working state, meter fill, Codex chip. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: signal-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal text (Codex chip).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs-you state, pending checks, warn tag, meter over threshold. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text (warn tag).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Tab colour 8 and squad accents. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: violet-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind violet text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done state, passing checks, open PR, added-line count. Always paired with a word or the +N figure.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed state, destructive menu items, deleted-line count, closed PR. Always paired with a word or the -N figure.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text (skipped-tab pill).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Claude Code agent chip and tab colour 2. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: orange-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind orange text (Claude chip).

tokens.name: brand-agent
tokens.usage: Logo v12 agent side only: the orange blade, or a sub-system shape, in BrandMark and the brand files. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: badge-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Ink on a custom badge fill that is light (picked from the fill luminance).

tokens.name: badge-ink-light
tokens.usage: Ink on a custom badge fill that is dark (picked from the fill luminance).

tokens.name: x-color-surface

tokens.name: x-color-muted

tokens.name: x-color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edge: 3:1 or more on x-color-bg, panel, surface and surface-2 and on bg-0 to bg-3 (SC 1.4.11). Use it where a border alone marks a field, checkbox, radio or switch; keep x-color-line for decorative dividers.
